name: UX Pilot
description: UX Pilot helps users create wireframes, high-fidelity UI screens, and multi-screen app flows from natural-language prompts inside Claude. Single-screen requests start generation in the user's UX Pilot workspace right away and show a live preview widget. Multi-screen flow requests first suggest screens; the user confirms selections in the widget before designs are generated. Users can open results in UX Pilot to continue editing.

_published_faq.name: How do I add UX Pilot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add UX Pilot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-server-485825078314.us-central1.run.app/mcp/ui. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the UX Pilot MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: UX Pilot provides these MCP tools: flow-generation and generate-design.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to UX Pilot?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to UX Pilot in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.

_published_faq.name: Does UX Pilot MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: UX Pilot requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
UX Pilot is developed by UX Pilot Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
